description: Aayy Patches: personal patches for use with Morphe

patches.name: Open web apps from other apps
patches.description: Lets shortcut apps such as Shortcut Maker open a saved web app directly, so you can make the home screen shortcut there instead of in Native Alpha. Other apps can only open web apps you have already saved, and fingerprint-locked web apps still ask for your fingerprint.

patches.name: Persist web app logins
patches.description: Saves a web app's cookies to disk every time you leave it, so logins and sessions survive closing the web app — including web apps opened straight from a home screen shortcut. Native Alpha otherwise keeps cookies only in memory and loses them when the web app's process ends.

patches.name: No screen lock passkey
patches.description: Skips the master password / PIN prompt for Bitwarden passkey sign-in and creation on a device with no secure lock screen. Devices with a PIN, pattern, password, or biometric lock are unchanged.

patches.name: Trust re-signed browsers for passkeys
patches.description: Lets you trust a Morphe-patched (re-signed) browser for passkeys. Normally Bitwarden hard-fails such a browser with "signature does not match" and offers no way to trust it; this routes it to the standard "trust this browser?" prompt instead, so you approve it once and it's remembered. Browsers whose signature already matches are unaffected.

release_notes: Removes the Native Alpha keep-shortcut-icon-shape patch (use Shortcut Maker for icons). Keeps: Bitwarden passkey patches, Native Alpha open-web-apps-from-other-apps, and persist-web-app-logins.
